67493-tales-of-the-air-mail-pilots.title: Tales Of The Air Mail Pilots
67493-tales-of-the-air-mail-pilots.creator: Unknown
67493-tales-of-the-air-mail-pilots.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. pilots and the purpose of the Air Mail Service. Every day, whatever the weather, two sturdy airplanes, loaded with mail, climb into the air above their respective flying fields near New York and San Francisco, and start across the continent. At the next landing field—there are thirteen of them between the two oceans—pilots and machines are changed, just as the crew and locomotive of the Limited are changed at each division point.

76297-the-constitutional-iniquity-involv.title: The Constitutional Iniquity Involved In All Forms Of The Reg
76297-the-constitutional-iniquity-involv.creator: Unknown
76297-the-constitutional-iniquity-involv.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It may be well to consider for a moment, carefully, the meaning of the word “constitutional;” the more so, as people are not even yet awake to the tremendous issues at stake in the case before us. The controversy throughout Europe and in our own colonies may be considered as a question of constitutional and legal rights.

arxiv-2102-11737.title: A PARAMETRIZED SET OF EXPLICIT ELEMENTS OF
arxiv-2102-11737.creator: 𝐗
arxiv-2102-11737.description: Abstract Received: 4/12/22, Revised: 9/5/22, Accepted: 11/20/22, Published: 12/16/22 Abstract In this paper a set of elliptic curves E with explicit elements of order 3 in their Tate-Shafarevich group is constructed. First, the theory of descent by 3 -isogeny is reviewed, including explicit equations for homogeneous spaces representing the elements in the associated Selmer group.

arxiv-2106-01602.title: The SIR model towards the data. One year of Covid-19 pandemic in Italy case study and plausible “real” numbers. (ACCEPTED as is at The European Physical Journal Plus on July 21, 2021)
arxiv-2106-01602.creator: I. Lazzizzera \corref mycorrespondingauthor
arxiv-2106-01602.description: Abstract In this work, the SIR epidemiological model is reformulated so to highlight the important effective reproduction number , as well as to account for the generation time , inverse of the incidence rate , and the infectious period (or removal period ), inverse of the removal rate .

arxiv-2111-03451.title: Small UAVs-supported Autonomous Generation of Fine-grained 3D Indoor Radio Environmental Maps
arxiv-2111-03451.creator: Ken Mendes, Filip Lemic, Jeroen Famaey
arxiv-2111-03451.description: Abstract REM are a powerful tool for enhancing the performance of various communication and networked agents. However, generating REMs is a laborious undertaking, especially in complex 3D ( 3D ) environments, such as indoors. To address this issue, we propose a system for autonomous generation of fine-grained REMs of indoor 3D spaces.

arxiv-2111-08043.title: The Photo-Astrometric Vertical Tracer Density of the Milky Way II: Results from Gaia . 2021 The Photo-Astrometric Vertical Tracer Density of the Milky Way II: Results from Gaia . – A.2
arxiv-2111-08043.creator: Andrew Everall, Vasily Belokurov, N. Wyn Evans, Douglas Boubert, Robert J. J. Grand
arxiv-2111-08043.description: Abstract We use Gaia photometry and astrometry to estimate the vertical spatial structure of the Milky Way at the Solar radius, formally accounting for sample incompleteness (the selection function) and parallax measurement uncertainty. Our results show impressive precision demonstrating the power of the Gaia data. However, systematic errors dominate the parameter value uncertainties.

arxiv-2304-02647.creator: Spandan Das, Pavithra Prabhakar
arxiv-2304-02647.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of probabilistic stability analysis of a subclass of Stochastic Hybrid Systems, namely, Polyhedral Probabilistic Hybrid Systems ( PPHS ) , where the flow dynamics is given by a polyhedral inclusion, the discrete switching between modes happens probabilistically at the boundaries of their invariant regions and the continuous state is not reset during

arxiv-2305-17622.title: Semi-inclusive decays of B B meson into a dark anti-baryon and baryons
arxiv-2305-17622.creator: Yu-Ji Shi 1,4 , Ye Xing 2 and Zhi-Peng Xing 3,5
arxiv-2305-17622.description: Abstract Using the recently developed B B -Mesogenesis scenario, we studied the semi-inclusive decays of B B meson into a dark anti-baryon ψ \psi plus any possible states X X containing u / c u/c and d / s d/s quarks with unit baryon number.

arxiv-2402-01737.title: Assistive Large Language Model Agents for Socially-Aware Negotiation Dialogues WARNING: This paper may contain model outputs that are offensive, non-inclusive, or biased.
arxiv-2402-01737.creator: Yuncheng Hua, Lizhen Qu, Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2402-01737.description: Abstract We develop assistive agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) that aid interlocutors in business negotiations. Specifically, we simulate business negotiations by letting two LLM-based agents engage in role play. A third LLM acts as a remediator agent to rewrite utterances violating norms for improving negotiation outcomes.

arxiv-2405-09415.title: On the Correspondence of Non-flat Assumption-based Argumentation and Logic Programming with Negation as Failure in the Head
arxiv-2405-09415.creator: Anna Rapberger, Markus Ulbricht, Francesca Toni
arxiv-2405-09415.description: Abstract The relation between (a fragment of) assumption-based argumentation (ABA) and logic programs (LPs) under stable model semantics is well-studied. However, for obtaining this relation, the ABA framework needs to be restricted to being flat, i.e., a fragment where the (defeasible) assumptions can never be entailed, only assumed to be true or false.

arxiv-2411-03436.title: Constraining accretion physics with gravitational waves from eccentric extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
arxiv-2411-03436.creator: Francisco Duque, Shubham Kejriwal, Laura Sberna, Lorenzo Speri, Jonathan Gair
arxiv-2411-03436.description: Abstract We study the evolution of eccentric, equatorial extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) immersed in the accretion disks of active galactic nuclei. We find that single gravitational-wave observations from these systems could provide measurements with ∼ 10 % \sim 10\% relative precision of, simultaneously, the disk viscosity and mass accretion rate of the central supermassive black hole.

arxiv-2501-11994.description: Abstract The Single Carrier-Frequency Division Multiple Access (SC-FDMA) is a transmission technique used in the uplink of Long Term Evolution (LTE) and 5G systems, as it is characterized by reduced transmitted signal envelope fluctuations in comparison to Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technique used in the downlink.

arxiv-2503-02501.title: Ehrhart spectra of large subsets in ℤ r \mathbb{Z}^{r}
arxiv-2503-02501.creator: Michael Björklund, Rickard Cullman, Alexander Fish
arxiv-2503-02501.description: Abstract . This paper introduces and studies the Ehrhart spectrum of a set E ⊆ ℤ r E\subseteq\mathbb{Z}^{r} , defined as the set of all Ehrhart polynomials of simplices with vertices in E E , generalizing the notion of volume spectrum.

arxiv-2505-10324.title: An Eccentric Sub-Neptune Moving Into the Evaporation Desert
arxiv-2505-10324.creator: Sydney A. Jenkins, Andrew Vanderburg, Ritika Sethi, Sarah Millholland, Joseph E. Rodriguez, Luca Fossati, Andreas Krenn, Emily Pass, Alexander Venner, R. Paul Butler, Hugh Osborn, Aaron Householder, Carl Ziegler, Juliette Becker, Perry Berlind, Allyson Bieryla, Christopher Broeg, Michael L. Calkins,
arxiv-2505-10324.description: Abstract Though missions such as Kepler , K2 , and TESS have discovered >2,000 sub-Neptune and Neptunian planets, there is a dearth of such planets at close-in (P ≲ \lesssim 3 days) orbits. This feature, called the Neptune desert or the evaporation desert, is believed to be primarily shaped by planetary migration and photoevaporation.

pmc-10682970.title: Racial, socioeconomic, and neighborhood characteristics in relation to COVID-19 severity of illness for adolescents and young adults
pmc-10682970.creator: Ayaat Dahleh, Andrew J Bean, Tricia J Johnson, Rebecca Seguin-Fowler
pmc-10682970.description: This study tests the hypotheses that insurance status, race and ethnicity, and neighborhood characteristics are associated with hospital admission and severe health outcomes (Intensive Care Unit [ICU] admission and oxygen assistance) for youth and young adults who present to the emergency department (ED) with COVID-19 in a single, academic health system in Illinois, Rush University System for Health (RUSH).

pmc-11347027.title: Establishment, Prediction, and Validation of a Nomogram for Cognitive Impairment in Elderly Patients With Diabetes
pmc-11347027.creator: Sensen Wu, Dikang Pan, Hui Wang, Julong Guo, Fan Zhang, Yachan Ning, Yongquan Gu, Lianrui Guo
pmc-11347027.description: Objective: The purpose of this study is to establish a predictive model of cognitive impairment in elderly people with diabetes. Methods: We analyzed a total of 878 elderly patients with diabetes who were part of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) from 2011 to 2014.

pmc-11647774.title: Sharp coefficient bounds for a class of symmetric starlike functions involving the balloon shape domain
pmc-11647774.creator: Bilal Khan, Jianhua Gong, Muhammad Ghaffar Khan, Fairouz Tchier
pmc-11647774.description: Recent research has extensively explored classes of starlike and convex functions across various domains. This study introduces a novel class of symmetric starlike functions with respect to symmetric points and associated with the balloon shape domain. We establish the explicit representation of all functions in this class.

pmc-11716829.description: BackgroundEducation, as a proxy for cognitive reserves, has been linked to dementia; however, the association between education attainment and brain health remains unclear. pmc-12603531.title: The genome sequence of the lesser black-backed gull, Larus fuscus Linnaeus, 1758
pmc-12603531.creator: Rosa Lopez Colom, Michelle F. O’Brien, Natural History Museum Genome Acquisition Lab, Darwin Tree of Life Barcoding collective, Wellcome Sanger Institute Tree of Life Management, Samples and Laboratory team, Wellcome Sanger Institute Scientific Operations: Sequencing Operations, Wellcome Sanger Inst
pmc-12603531.description: We present a genome assembly from an individual female Larus fuscus (the lesser black-backed gull; Chordata; Aves; Charadriiformes; Laridae). The genome sequence has a total length of 1,324.30 megabases. Most of the assembly (90.38%) is scaffolded into 32 chromosomal pseudomolecules, including the Z sex chromosome. The mitochondrial genome has also been assembled and is 16.75 kilobases in length.

pmc-12733715.title: Sexual Size Dimorphism Depends Drastically on Environment: The Case Study in Ground Beetles
pmc-12733715.creator: Chiara Ferracini, Enrico Busato, Viktor Alexanov, Igor A Solodovnikov, Teodora Teofilova, Vladimir Langraf, Alexander Borisovskiy, Sergey Luzyanin, Alexander Ruchin, Dominik Stočes, Anatoliy L Anciferov, Roman P Gorbunov, Raisa A Sukhodolskaya, Roberto Romani
pmc-12733715.description: Simple SummaryWe estimated the nature of size variation in Carabus granulatus beetles captured in different parts of their range, including most of Russia and Europe. Our results showed that the sizes of both females and males vary statistically significantly across regions, although not always to the same extent.

pmc-13289428.title: Linking somatic mutations in cancer to the electronic properties of DNA
pmc-13289428.creator: Benoît de Witte, Cyril Karamaoun, Pauline Hermans, Maxime Tarabichi, Fabrizio Pucci, Marianne Rooman
pmc-13289428.description: Oxidative stress, generated by both endogenous and exogenous agents, can cause DNA lesions that, if not repaired, accumulate as somatic mutations and can contribute to cancer initiation. Here, we explored this problem through the lens of DNA electronic properties, quantified by the vertical ionization potential (vIP) of nucleobase motifs, which reflects their susceptibility to oxidation.

pmc-13296785.title: A Novel Swarm Intelligence-Driven Feature Selection for Interpretable Machine Learning in Multiparametric MRI-Based GBM Overall Survival Analysis
pmc-13296785.creator: Abdulkerim Duman, Xianfang Sun, James R. Powell, Emiliano Spezi
pmc-13296785.description: Simple SummaryThis study developed and validated an interpretable machine learning (ML) model using a novel swarm intelligence (SI)-based feature selection method with multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-derived radiomic features (RFs) to estimate overall survival (OS) in patients with glioblastoma multiforme (GBM).

pmc-13464636.title: Photonic time crystals assisted by quasi-bound states in the continuum
pmc-13464636.creator: Puneet Garg, Evangelos Almpanis, Leander Zimmer, Jan David Fischbach, Xuchen Wang, Mohammad S. Mirmoosa, Markus Nyman, Nikolaos Stefanou, Nikolaos Papanikolaou, Viktar Asadchy, Carsten Rockstuhl
pmc-13464636.description: Photonic time crystals (PTCs) are characterized by the rapid modulation of the material properties in time, causing a momentum bandgap for light. However, the observation of these bandgaps at optical frequencies remains elusive as the necessary temporal modulation amplitudes to show notable momentum bandgaps are relatively high, inaccessible with available materials.

pmc-13594041.title: Economic Impact of PromarkerD In Vitro Diagnostic Testing on the Management of Chronic Kidney Disease in Type 2 Diabetes: A Budget Impact Analysis
pmc-13594041.creator: Gareth C Fernandez, Isabella A Joubert, Kirsten E Peters, Lianzhi K Chen, Jacqueline S Gray, Pearl L Tan, Michael Shanik, Richard J Lipscombe
pmc-13594041.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluated the clinical and economic impact of integrating Promarker®D, a validated biomarker-based blood test that predicts kidney function decline up to 4 years before clinical evidence of chronic kidney disease (CKD), into routine management of patients with type 2 diabetes (T2D) from a US healthcare payer perspective.

pmc-13644063.title: A biomimetic cryoprotectant preserves extracellular vesicles bioactivity for intravenous administration and potentiates wound healing
pmc-13644063.creator: Pingao Zhang, Xinkai Nie, Hongwei Mao, Youyou Zhang, Jing Wang, Lufeng Wang, Rui Qin, Xiaoli Yang, Wanying Huang, Xiaoling Gao, Chenghuan Song, Yongfang Zhang, Hao Wang
pmc-13644063.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) have emerged as promising vehicles for drug delivery and disease therapy owing to their intrinsic biocompatibility and capacity to transfer functional biomolecules. However, limitations in current storage technologies, including structural degradation and bioactivity loss during long-term freezing, and the incompatibility of conventional cryoprotectants such as DMSO and glycerol with intravenous administration, pose major barriers to clinical translation.

uslaw-usc-t16-s482l.title: 16 U.S.C. § 482l — Perfection of mining claims within forest
uslaw-usc-t16-s482l.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s482l.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 2 (National Forests); Subchapter I (Establishment And Administration). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Valid mining claims within the said lands, existing on June 10, 1949, and thereafter maintained in compliance with the law under which they were initiated and the laws of the State of New Mexico, may be perfected under sections 482j to 482l.
